newsitem.title: USA: Entergy cuts output at Arkansas 1 nuclear unit.
newsitem.headline: Entergy cuts output at Arkansas 1 nuclear unit.

text.p: Entergy Corp, Inc cut power output at its 836 megawatt (MW) Arkansas 1 nuclear power plant for repair work on the unit's turbine, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
The unit, in Russellville, Ark., was operating at full power on Friday.
The NRC, in its daily plant status report, said output at Arkansas 1 had been brought down to 12 percent after taking the turbine off line.
It gave no estimate of how long the plant was likely to by operating at reduced power.
The adjoining unit, Arkansas 2, was operating at its full 858 MW rated capacity, the report said.
